description: This file implements an alert handling driver for NCT38XX GPIO devices in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, callback handling, and alert status checking.

methods.name: nct38xx_alert_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked on GPIO interrupt, submits alert worker.

methods.name: nct38xx_alert_is_active
methods.description: Checks if the NCT38XX alert is active by reading and clearing alert registers.

methods.name: nct38xx_alert_worker
methods.description: Worker function that processes active alerts for each device.

methods.name: nct38xx_alert_init
methods.description: Initializes the alert driver, configures GPIO, and sets up callbacks.
